subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of these requested native core surfaces now: file/search batching, AI-callable context blocks, or submitted-plan enforcement?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, session/context persistence semantics, and opt-in enforcement/config policy, while current VISION.md only partially aligns and warns against heavy orchestration or optional capability that can live through plugins/API seams.

options.title: Split for design review
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Route pieces to plugins
options.body: Defer core changes unless a concrete plugin/API gap is proven, using existing Parallel Search, Tokenjuice, and context-engine seams where adequate.

options.title: Decline core direction
options.body: Close the umbrella as not planned if maintainers decide native batching, context blocks, and plan enforcement are outside core scope for now.

recommendation.title: Split for design review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on `update_plan`, strict-agentic behavior, and current tool/context efficiency surfaces.
